content: Bulus a Kolanti
Kalkǝ gu, i Bulus za' Atina illǝ Kolanti.
Tyaka is ma isǝ mul Yahudu won mul shin Akila, atl zǝtti ki Pantas, ta lǝndǝb patl su' Italiya uwai nǝ kǝli wasi Biliskila, gaki Kalaudiyas bǝl zhil mus Yahudawa sǝ'za' Loma. I Bulus lǝɗǝ yas si.
Gaki kyautǝn wasǝn nǝm kǝni ki tlotlti tanti ni, iddǝmi ati kyautǝn ne'si.
Mus cin shuti ati shotti bi nesi a ge'lu dobga ki Yahudawa, ati tle ga ki Yahudawa ne' ginǝ bǝ Yahudawa wai u.
Nǝki Sila nǝ Timothy pe'te' Makidoniya, i Bulus gob mbǝtl dlǝb shilǝn ki Lya tǝnki, ati mboki Yahudawa toh Yesu tikǝ Almasihu.
Amma is nge dlǝmti ki Bulus asi byatlti, ibba bat lulutwas taka i' ulsisu, “Hwula wakǝn a ga wakǝn! Ulǝn alakǝn wai. Nǝguni an lǝti ma' ginǝ bǝ Yahudawai u.
I Bulus za'lu dobga ki Yahudawa illǝtǝn dlabi libi ki Titus Yustus, mul bǝdl Lya libi wasi nja nǝ lu dopga ki Yahudawa.
I Kilibus, mul kina ki lu dobga, ne' mus libi wasi is la' mbatl nǝ Lya; Kolantiyawa dǝɓǝli mi' kub Bulus is la' mbadlǝ i pǝlisi baptisma.
A ge' gason i Lya shilǝn nǝ Bulus ge' tlu'ti: “Bǝkum ɓantwai; gob shilǝn ki Lya, bi dǝm shotwai.
Gaki ami miki, mulǝn kǝn tile' ki dlati a' kumi' ciwowai, ami nǝ mbalǝn diɓǝli age' gatlu.”
I Bulus dǝm a Kolanti ti kulcissi shilǝn ki Lya, hwon nǝm nǝ bwasti dlom.
Amma nǝ Galiyo ɗǝ mul kina ki atl ki Akaya u, i Yahudawa ki Kolinti is maga is tlih Bulus nǝ mbatl nǝm is mbǝlti akina ɗǝ mi'pǝlt shilǝn.
“Mulgu,” si usu, “Ti tle ga ki mbalǝn sǝbbǝl Lya tǝn shitu u nǝ bǝ zhil kǝn wai u.”
Nǝ Bulus ɗǝ lyap shilǝn u, i Galiyo ulsisu, “Kini Yahudawa ki shilǝn tǝn lati asǝn giɓi u, tǝ kapbi pǝldli ma u, da an gaki' kin kǝm.
Amma tun nǝ shoti bi katl ki lǝntu, nǝ shin nǝ zhil lwakǝn u likǝnin nǝ gawakǝn. Akǝn shilǝnti tǝn undǝ giwai.”
Iki i' katsi taka ɗǝ bidla pǝtl shilǝn.
I mbalǝn ki lǝbi is gop Sastanisu mul kina ki lu dobga is li'ti a kina ɗǝ lu pǝtl shilǝn; amma Galiyo ta pǝl ulǝn tǝn kiwai.
I Bulus pal tya Antakiya ki Suliya
I Bulus lǝm mutti a Kolinti. Is za' yelsǝni mudli nǝ mwanǝ it tege' kundǝlǝn ki mal illǝ Siliya, nǝ Biliskila nǝ Akila. Kapin tǝzzaga, i' utl ga taka a Kakiliya gaki dlǝtlti u nǝ' pǝli u.
Is mbǝkǝci Apisa, alǝbi Bulus za' Biliskila nǝ Akila. Tinǝ gawasi it te'ge' lu dobga ti shotti bi ne' Yahudawa.
Nǝs ngemti tǝl lǝm dǝp ne' si u, in nge.
Amma nǝ' pal bi ne' si u, i' usu, “Anpalti teɗi in Lya a ndǝgu.” Iki is za' Apisa i' tege' kundǝlǝn ki mal.
Nǝm mbǝkǝci a Kaisaliya u, illǝ Ulshelima it shin ni Ikilisiya iki illǝ Antakiya.
Kalki lǝb muttwas tya Antakiya, i Bulus hiliya ɗǝlǝbi i' gob lǝt tya ge' lu nǝ lu ge' atl ki Galatiya nǝ Palijiya, ati ndǝlli' mi' bǝtl Yesu kal mbadli.
Iki i mul Yahudiya won mul shin Apolos, atl ki zǝtti ki Iskandaliya, immbǝ Apisa. Mul mallǝɓa ni, tǝ man shilǝn ki Lya ki lwabbati iye.
A kulci' shitu ki mal Lya yi, ti shilǝn ki Lya nǝ mbotlti, ti dlib lǝɓa tin Yesu kǝnǝ kan unǝ ɗa u, amma baptisma ki Yahaya tǝ mani katl.
Iki gob dlib shilǝn ki Lya bǝ nǝ ɓultwai age' lu dobga ki yahudawa. Amma nǝki Bilkisu nǝ Akila kumtu, is mbebbi a libi ɗasi ka is mbǝl dlimitti shitu ki mal Lya ɗa iye.
Nǝ Apolos lyam ɗakǝshti tya Akaya u, i yalsǝni ɗǝlti is laci mi'bǝtl Yesu kal sǝn njeti in ta mbǝ u, Mbǝkǝshtwasi ma ginǝ lambatl nǝ Yesu tu tǝn zo' lǝɓa ki mulban i dǝm nǝ dǝlti iye tǝnsi.
Gaki ta la' Yahudawa nǝ shotti bi mul ndǝlti iye ge' mbalǝn i, ti dlimissi tu' ge' lwabbati Yesu tikǝ Almasihu.
